ev.band_offer.desc: {name} shows up with an old guitar: "Me on vocals, you on everything else. Let's conquer the world."
ev.band_offer.title: Wanna start a band?
ev.band_offer.yes.res: A garage, a borrowed amp and huge dreams.
ev.blackout.desc: The whole city goes dark for a night.
ev.blackout.mana.res: A small orb of light floats over the table. Nobody asks.
ev.blackout.title: Blackout
ev.burnout_event.desc: You stare at the screen for 40 minutes without typing. Your body is begging for help.
ev.burnout_event.leave.res: Two weeks away from everything. You can breathe again.
ev.burnout_event.push.res: You hold on. Until you can't.
ev.burnout_event.title: At the limit
ev.car_accident.brace.res: Insurance covers part. You cover the rest.
ev.car_accident.desc: A car runs the red light and comes straight at you.
ev.car_accident.dodge.ok: A perfect turn of the wheel. Heart in your throat.
ev.car_accident.title: Crash
ev.car_breakdown.desc: Your car starts smoking in the middle of the highway.
ev.car_breakdown.title: The car died
ev.child_asks_money.desc: {name} wants to start a business and asks you to invest.
ev.child_asks_money.title: Help for the future
ev.child_rebel.desc: {name} got home at 4 a.m., smelling of smoke, and slammed the bedroom door.
ev.child_rebel.talk.ok: {name} breaks down and tells you everything. You understand each other.
ev.child_rebel.title: Rebel phase
ev.child_success.desc: {name}'s business took off! It's even in the news. In the interview, {name} thanks you.
ev.child_success.ok.res: {name} pays back your investment many times over.
ev.child_success.title: Family pride
ev.classic_car_offer.buy.res: With a good restoration, this is worth a fortune.
ev.classic_car_offer.desc: An old man wants to sell a dusty vintage sports car from his garage. "It was my father's."
ev.classic_car_offer.pass.res: You think about it for years.
ev.classic_car_offer.title: A classic for sale
ev.competitor_attack.desc: A giant competitor slashes prices to drive you out of the market.
ev.competitor_attack.fight.fail: You burn cash and lose the battle.
ev.competitor_attack.fight.ok: Your campaign goes viral. Customers stay with you.
ev.competitor_attack.title: Price war
ev.crew_job.desc: {name} proposes: "A warehouse with no alarm. Half is yours."
ev.crew_job.in.ok: Cash in your pocket. Heart racing.
ev.crew_job.out.res: {name} calls you a coward. That's fine.
ev.crew_job.title: A "small job"
ev.crime_investigation.desc: "We have some questions about an old case." Your past has caught up with you.
ev.crime_investigation.flee.ok: You vanish. You're a fugitive now.
ev.crime_investigation.title: Police at the door
ev.distant_inheritance.desc: A lawyer calls: a great-uncle you never met left you everything.
ev.distant_inheritance.ok.res: Sometimes luck knocks on the door.
ev.distant_inheritance.title: Unexpected inheritance
ev.doping_offer.refuse.res: You win clean or not at all.
ev.doping_offer.take.res: Faster, stronger... and afraid of every test.
ev.doping_offer.title: A "little help"
ev.fam_parent_sick.desc: {name} is sick and the treatment is expensive.
ev.fam_parent_sick.heal.res: A discreet green light. The doctors call it a miracle.
ev.fam_parent_sick.pay.res: {name} recovers. "I don't know how to thank you."
ev.fam_parent_sick.title: News from the hospital
ev.fam_sibling_loan.desc: {name} asks to borrow money. "I swear I'll pay you back."
ev.fam_sibling_loan.title: Family loan
ev.familiar_bond.desc: For the first time, your familiar sends a thought straight into your mind: "Master... stronger. Together."
ev.familiar_bond.feed.res: The familiar glows and grows a little. It looks satisfied.
ev.familiar_bond.title: The familiar speaks
ev.familiar_bond.train.res: You move as one. The System logs: « Synchrony ».
ev.fight_police.desc: The fight caught the police's attention.
ev.fight_police.run.fail: Handcuffed. A fine and a record.
ev.fight_police.run.ok: You jump a wall and vanish.
ev.fight_police.title: Sirens
ev.fin_bankruptcy.declare.res: You lose your credit, but gain room to start over.
ev.fin_bankruptcy.desc: The bank called for the tenth time. Your debts are past the point of no return.
ev.fin_bankruptcy.family.ok: Your family pays off half. Their look weighs more than the debt.
ev.fin_bankruptcy.grind.res: You cut everything and grit your teeth.
ev.fin_bankruptcy.title: Drowning in debt
ev.found_wallet.desc: A fat wallet on the ground. ID and plenty of cash.
ev.found_wallet.return.res: The owner nearly cries with gratitude.
ev.found_wallet.title: Lost wallet
ev.friend_loan.desc: {name} is desperate. "I need money. Only you can help me."
ev.friend_loan.title: A friend in trouble
ev.friend_saves_you.desc: When you needed it most, {name} appears. "You forgave my debt years ago. Now it's my turn."
ev.friend_saves_you.ok.res: Some seeds take years to bear fruit.
ev.friend_saves_you.title: A debt of gratitude
ev.grandparent_wisdom.ask.res: {name} whispers: "Our family has always seen the windows."
ev.grandparent_wisdom.desc: {name} tells stories from their youth. One of them sounds strangely like a Dungeon.
ev.grandparent_wisdom.listen.res: You learn more in an afternoon than in a year of school.
ev.grandparent_wisdom.title: Grandparent's stories
ev.guild_invite.arcane.res: A worn grimoire is placed in your hands: "Start with the basics."
ev.guild_invite.desc:
Three envelopes appear on your desk without anyone delivering them.
• Iron Fist — brute force and honor.
• Arcane Order — magic and knowledge.
• Moon Shadow — information and silent blades.
ev.guild_invite.iron.res: You're welcomed with a handshake that nearly breaks your fingers.
ev.guild_invite.shadow.res: Nobody greets you. But the next morning there's a dagger on your pillow.
ev.guild_invite.solo.res: You burn the envelopes. The System approves: « +5 attribute points ».
ev.guild_invite.title: The Guilds Come Calling
ev.guild_noticed.deny.fail: He laughs. "Lying isn't your highest stat." Rumours begin to spread.
ev.guild_noticed.desc: A man in a suit waits at your dungeon's exit. "Rifts don't open this often on their own. You're on the radar."
ev.guild_noticed.reveal.res: He hands you a card. "The guilds will love you."
ev.guild_noticed.title: Someone is watching
ev.health_warning.change.res: Diet, walking, sleep. Boring — and it works.
ev.health_warning.desc: "If you keep this up, you won't make it to 60."
ev.health_warning.ignore.res: You order a triple burger on the way home.
ev.health_warning.title: The doctor was blunt
ev.humor_celebrity.deny.res: General disappointment. One fan asks for a selfie anyway.
ev.humor_celebrity.desc: A group of fans screams and runs toward you. They think you're a TV star.
ev.humor_celebrity.play.res: You sign 40 autographs with a name that isn't yours.
ev.humor_celebrity.title: Are you famous?
ev.humor_pigeon.accept.res: Gamer's Mind shields you from the shame. Almost.
ev.humor_pigeon.chase.fail: The pigeon eats your snack while staring into your eyes.
ev.humor_pigeon.chase.ok: You get your snack back. « +1 EXP ». Glorious.
ev.humor_pigeon.desc: A pigeon steals your snack right out of your hand. The System displays: « Pigeon — Lv. 1 ». Humiliating.
ev.humor_pigeon.title: Winged thief
ev.influencer_collab.desc: {name}, another trending creator, proposes a video together.
ev.influencer_collab.no.res: You'd rather grow your own way.
ev.influencer_collab.title: Collab proposal
ev.investment_tip.desc: An acquaintance swears a startup is about to take off. "Put in 5k, trust me."
ev.investment_tip.invest.fail: The startup went bust in three months.
ev.investment_tip.invest.ok: The startup got acquired! Your 5k became 22.
ev.investment_tip.observe.res: « Trait: Manipulative ». You keep your money.
ev.investment_tip.title: Hot tip
ev.investor_offer.accept.res: More money, more pressure, more speed.
ev.investor_offer.decline.res: The company is yours. Only yours.
ev.investor_offer.desc: A fund wants to inject capital into your company in exchange for equity.
ev.investor_offer.title: An investor shows up
ev.jury_duty.desc: You're selected for the jury of a fraud case.
ev.jury_duty.observe.res: « Trait: Dishonest ». You know the truth before anyone else.
ev.jury_duty.serve.res: You understand how justice works from the inside.
ev.jury_duty.title: Jury duty
ev.kid_genius_test.desc: The school runs a test. The teacher looks at your result twice.
ev.kid_genius_test.ok.res: "Gifted." Your parents beam — and the pressure rises.
ev.kid_genius_test.title: IQ test
ev.kid_new_friend.desc: At the playground, {name} offers you half of their snack.
ev.kid_new_friend.refuse.res: {name} goes off to play with someone else.
ev.kid_new_friend.share.res: You spend the afternoon building an "indestructible" sandcastle.
ev.kid_new_friend.title: A new little friend
ev.kid_parents_fight.desc: Your parents are fighting again. You hear your name in the middle of it.
ev.kid_parents_fight.headphones.res: You turn up the volume until you hear nothing.
ev.kid_parents_fight.intervene.ok: They stop, ashamed, and hug you.
ev.kid_parents_fight.title: Shouting in the kitchen
ev.kid_pet_request.ask.ok: You get a dog named Bit. Best day ever.
ev.kid_pet_request.desc: You saw a puppy in a shop window and can't stop thinking about it.
ev.kid_pet_request.title: Can I have a dog?
ev.kid_talent_show.desc: The school is holding a talent show. Are you brave enough?
ev.kid_talent_show.sing.fail: Your voice cracks on the chorus. The laughter echoes for weeks.
ev.kid_talent_show.sing.ok: Standing ovation! Someone films it and posts it.
ev.kid_talent_show.skip.res: You cheer for others. That's fine too.
ev.kid_talent_show.title: Talent show
ev.kid_tantrum.calm.res: A calm strange for a child. {name} is impressed.
ev.kid_tantrum.desc: You WANT that candy. {name} said no.
ev.kid_tantrum.scream.fail: You get carried out under an arm.
ev.kid_tantrum.scream.ok: Embarrassed, {name} buys the candy. Sweet victory.
ev.kid_tantrum.title: Supermarket meltdown
ev.loan_more.business.fail: The business sinks. And takes more of your money with it.
ev.loan_more.business.ok: The business works! {name} finally pays — and much more.
ev.loan_more.desc: {name} comes back. Not to pay — to ask for more.
ev.loan_more.title: Asking for more
ev.loan_return.collect.ok: {name} pays it all back, with interest. "Thanks for trusting me."
ev.loan_return.desc: Years later, {name} shows up. You remember the money. So does {name}.
ev.loan_return.forgive.res: "I'll repay you. Someday." {name} seems to mean it.
ev.loan_return.title: The loan
ev.love_meet.ask.ok: {name} says yes. You set a date for Saturday.
ev.love_meet.desc: You meet {name}. The conversation flows surprisingly well.
ev.love_meet.friend.res: A new friend on the list.
ev.love_meet.observe.res: The window shows compatibility, traits and... a secret. Information is power.
ev.love_meet.title: Someone interesting
ev.mentor_lesson.combat.res: You get beaten for hours. Every bruise becomes experience.
ev.mentor_lesson.desc: {name} shows up unannounced. "Today you'll learn something no book teaches."
ev.mentor_lesson.escape.res: "Rule number one: know how to leave." You learn Dungeon Escape.
ev.mentor_lesson.magic.fail: Nothing happens. "Come back when you're smarter."
ev.mentor_lesson.magic.ok: A blue spark leaps from your fingers. « Skill acquired ».
ev.mentor_lesson.title: Mentor's lesson
ev.midlife_crisis.car.res: Vroom. The crisis shrinks. So does your bank balance.
ev.midlife_crisis.desc: You look in the mirror: "Is this it? Is this all?"
ev.midlife_crisis.dream.res: It's never too late. The System agrees: « +3 points ».
ev.midlife_crisis.title: Midlife crisis
ev.music_discovered.desc: After busking, someone hands you a card: an indie label.
ev.music_discovered.no.res: Music is a hobby. For now.
ev.music_discovered.title: A producer in the crowd
ev.mysterious_shop.book.res: The book is warm to the touch.
ev.mysterious_shop.desc: In an alley, an old shop you've never seen. The shopkeeper smiles: "I have exactly what you need."
ev.mysterious_shop.fruit.res: It tastes like mango and power.
ev.mysterious_shop.leave.res: When you look back, the shop is gone.
ev.mysterious_shop.title: The shop that wasn't there
ev.neighbor_noise.desc: {name}, the upstairs neighbor, throws a party every Tuesday at 3 a.m.
ev.neighbor_noise.talk.fail: The door slams in your face.
ev.neighbor_noise.talk.ok: {name} apologizes and invites you to the next one. At 9 p.m.
ev.neighbor_noise.title: Noisy neighbor
ev.old_age_reflection.desc: Sitting on the porch, you revisit the status window of your whole life.
ev.old_age_reflection.share.res: Your grandchildren listen wide-eyed. Maybe one of them will inherit the System.
ev.old_age_reflection.title: Looking back
ev.old_age_reflection.write.res: "My Life in Levels". A modest bestseller.
ev.old_bandmate_tour.desc: {name}, your old bandmate, is famous now. "I need someone I trust on tour. Will you drop everything?"
ev.old_bandmate_tour.go.res: The road, the stages, the life you almost had. Now it's yours.
ev.old_bandmate_tour.stay.res: You watch {name}'s show from the crowd.
ev.old_bandmate_tour.title: Tour invitation
ev.parents_divorce.dad.res: You start seeing your mother on weekends.
ev.parents_divorce.desc: They sit you on the couch. "This isn't your fault." It still hurts.
ev.parents_divorce.mom.res: You start seeing your father on weekends.
ev.parents_divorce.title: Your parents are splitting up
ev.partner_finds_out.confess.ok: {name} cries, but decides to try again. Trust will never be the same.
ev.partner_finds_out.deny.fail: The lie makes it worse. Everyone finds out.
ev.partner_finds_out.desc: {name} slams a phone on the table. A photo from your trip. "Explain this."
ev.partner_finds_out.title: The past came back
ev.party_stranger.dance.ok: You dance until the party ends.
ev.party_stranger.desc: {name} keeps looking at you from across the room.
ev.party_stranger.title: Eyes across the party
ev.pet_hero.desc: At dawn, your pet won't stop barking until you wake up: there's a gas leak in the kitchen.
ev.pet_hero.ok.res: The whole neighborhood hears about it. Your pet earns lifetime treats.
ev.pet_hero.title: Four-legged hero
ev.pet_sick.desc: Your companion hasn't eaten in days and barely leaves its corner.
ev.pet_sick.heal.res: A green glow and your pet jumps into your lap.
ev.pet_sick.title: Your pet is sick
ev.pet_sick.vet.res: Some medicine, a scare, and the tail is wagging again.
ev.pet_sick.wait.res: Sleepless nights. But it seems it'll be okay.
ev.prison_fight.avoid.res: You keep your head down. For now.
ev.prison_fight.desc: {name} wants to show who runs the yard.
ev.prison_fight.fight.ok: Nobody messes with you in there anymore.
ev.prison_fight.title: Prison yard
ev.prison_mentor.desc: {name}, locked up for 30 years, offers to teach you "the trade".
ev.prison_mentor.learn.res: Hairpins will never be just hairpins again.
ev.prison_mentor.study: Ask to learn to read properly
ev.prison_mentor.title: The old man in cell 12
ev.rare_meteor.absorb.res: Golden light enters your chest. You were never the same again.
ev.rare_meteor.desc: A fist-sized meteorite fragment smokes in your backyard. It pulses. The System window flickers: « Item: Star Core (???) ».
ev.rare_meteor.sell.res: A collector pays a fortune, no questions asked.
ev.rare_meteor.title: A star fell in the backyard
ev.rare_time_loop.desc: You wake up and it's yesterday. Again. And again. On the 47th repeat, the System finally speaks: « Loop closed. Reward for persistence. »
ev.rare_time_loop.ok.res: You remember everything from the loops. Wisdom that's hard to explain.
ev.rare_time_loop.title: [SYSTEM] Temporal anomaly
ev.rival_awakened.decline.res: "Coward." {name} spits on the ground and leaves.
ev.rival_awakened.desc: {name} (Lv. {actor_level}) blocks your path. "They say you're the rookie clearing dungeons. Let's see."
ev.rival_awakened.duel.fail: You lose badly. But the System records every blow you took.
ev.rival_awakened.duel.ok: {name} drops to one knee. Word spreads among the Awakened.
ev.rival_awakened.title: An Awakened rival
ev.rival_rematch.desc: {name} is back. Stronger (Lv. {actor_level}). Their eyes burn with grudge: "I didn't forget."
ev.rival_rematch.fight.fail: This time {name} holds nothing back. You wake up in the hospital.
ev.rival_rematch.fight.ok: After the fight, {name} laughs and offers a hand. Rivals become friends.
ev.rival_rematch.talk.fail: {name} is not in the mood to talk.
ev.rival_rematch.talk.ok: You share a drink. The grudge fades.
ev.rival_rematch.title: The rematch
ev.rom_anniversary.desc: Tomorrow is your anniversary with {name}. You almost forgot.
ev.rom_anniversary.forget.res: {name} says nothing. The silence says everything.
ev.rom_anniversary.letter.fail: It came out a bit generic...
ev.rom_anniversary.title: Wedding anniversary
ev.rom_divorce_request.desc: {name} has decided. The papers are on the table.
ev.rom_divorce_request.therapy.res: It's hard, but you relearn how to talk.
ev.rom_divorce_request.title: "I want a divorce"
ev.rom_partner_cheated.desc: You find messages from {name} to someone else. There's no doubt.
ev.rom_partner_cheated.observe.res: The window reveals everything about the lover. You keep the information... for later.
ev.rom_partner_cheated.title: Betrayal
ev.rom_partner_proposes.desc: {name} kneels with a ring. "Will you marry me?"
ev.rom_partner_proposes.no.res: {name} puts the ring away in silence.
ev.rom_partner_proposes.title: On one knee
ev.scam_call.desc: "This is your bank. We need to confirm your password."
ev.scam_call.give.fail: The next day, your account is lighter.
ev.scam_call.give.ok: Mid-sentence you realize it's a scam and hang up.
ev.scam_call.title: Suspicious call
ev.school_bully.befriend.ok: Turns out {name} just wanted attention. You become friends.
ev.school_bully.desc: {name} knocks your backpack to the floor and laughs. "What are you gonna do?"
ev.school_bully.fight.fail: You get beaten. But the System logs: « VIT +xp ».
ev.school_bully.fight.ok: One punch. Just one. {name} never bothered you again.
ev.school_bully.title: The bully
ev.school_caught_skipping.desc: The school called. {name} is waiting at the door, arms crossed.
ev.school_caught_skipping.lie.fail: The lie crumbles. Grounded for a month.
ev.school_caught_skipping.title: Caught skipping school
ev.school_caught_skipping.truth.res: {name} is disappointed, but respects the honesty.
ev.school_club.chess.res: You learn to think ten moves ahead.
ev.school_club.desc: Club season has started. Which one do you pick?
ev.school_club.title: School clubs
ev.school_crush.admire.res: You write {name}'s name in your notebook. That's all.
ev.school_crush.confess.fail: "I... see you as a friend." Ouch.
ev.school_crush.confess.ok: {name} blushes and says yes. First love!
ev.school_crush.desc: Every time {name} walks by, your Stress bar goes up and so does Happiness. Weird.
ev.school_crush.title: Hallway crush
ev.school_exam.cheat.fail: The teacher tears your exam up in front of the class.
ev.school_exam.cheat.ok: Nobody saw. High grade, not-so-clear conscience.
ev.school_exam.desc: An exam worth half the grade. You didn't study as much as you should have.
ev.school_exam.focus.ok: The answers appear as if in a System window.
ev.school_exam.title: Pop quiz
ev.school_expulsion_risk.desc: The principal calls you in. "One more absence and you're out."
ev.school_expulsion_risk.shrug.res: Expelled. Your parents don't speak to you for days. New paths open — not all of them good.
ev.school_expulsion_risk.title: Final warning
ev.sports_scout.desc: A scout saw you play. "You've got something special."
ev.sports_scout.title: Scout
ev.sports_scout.tryout.ok: Approved! A sports career opens up.
ev.stray_animal.adopt.res: Now it has a home. And you have a friend.
ev.stray_animal.desc: A soaked puppy follows you all the way home.
ev.stray_animal.shelter.res: You leave the puppy in good hands.
ev.stray_animal.title: A puppy in the rain
ev.street_crowd.desc: Skipping school, you meet {name}, who seems to have money a little too easily.
ev.street_crowd.leave.res: Something tells you to stay away.
ev.street_crowd.title: Shady company
ev.sys_dungeon_break.desc: A massive rift opens downtown. Monsters flood the streets. The guilds haven't arrived yet.
ev.sys_dungeon_break.family.res: You get everyone to safety. No one in your family is hurt.
ev.sys_dungeon_break.fight.fail: You save a few people, but pay dearly.
ev.sys_dungeon_break.fight.ok: You hold the line until the guilds arrive. Videos of you go viral.
ev.sys_dungeon_break.hide.res: You survive. The guilt, less so.
ev.sys_dungeon_break.title: Dungeon Break!
ev.sys_evolution_1.body.res: Muscles rewrite themselves. You feel you could lift a car.
ev.sys_evolution_1.desc:
Your body burns from within. The limits of an ordinary human no longer apply to you.

Choose the direction of your evolution.
ev.sys_evolution_1.mind.res: The world slows down. You see patterns in everything.
ev.sys_evolution_1.soul.res: Something intangible shifts. People look at you as if you glow.
ev.sys_evolution_1.title: [SYSTEM] Existence Evolution 1
ev.sys_evolution_2.body.res: Muscles rewrite themselves. You feel you could lift a car.
ev.sys_evolution_2.desc:
Your body burns from within. The limits of an ordinary human no longer apply to you.

Choose the direction of your evolution.
ev.sys_evolution_2.mind.res: The world slows down. You see patterns in everything.
ev.sys_evolution_2.soul.res: Something intangible shifts. People look at you as if you glow.
ev.sys_evolution_2.title: [SYSTEM] Existence Evolution 2
ev.sys_evolution_3.body.res: Muscles rewrite themselves. You feel you could lift a car.
ev.sys_evolution_3.desc:
Your body burns from within. The limits of an ordinary human no longer apply to you.

Choose the direction of your evolution.
ev.sys_evolution_3.mind.res: The world slows down. You see patterns in everything.
ev.sys_evolution_3.soul.res: Something intangible shifts. People look at you as if you glow.
ev.sys_evolution_3.title: [SYSTEM] Existence Evolution 3
ev.sys_evolution_4.body.res: Muscles rewrite themselves. You feel you could lift a car.
ev.sys_evolution_4.desc:
Your body burns from within. The limits of an ordinary human no longer apply to you.

Choose the direction of your evolution.
ev.sys_evolution_4.mind.res: The world slows down. You see patterns in everything.
ev.sys_evolution_4.soul.res: Something intangible shifts. People look at you as if you glow.
ev.sys_evolution_4.title: [SYSTEM] Existence Evolution 4
ev.sys_first_awakened_seen.approach.fail: {name} pretends not to understand and vanishes into the crowd. But now they know who you are.
ev.sys_first_awakened_seen.approach.ok: {name} smiles. "So you see the windows too." That night you learn to open an Instant Dungeon.
ev.sys_first_awakened_seen.desc: You Observe {name} out of habit... and the window reads « Lv. {actor_level} ». Ordinary people are level 1. {name} notices your stare.
ev.sys_first_awakened_seen.hide.res: You keep the secret. For now.
ev.sys_first_awakened_seen.title: An impossible level
ev.sys_inheritance.desc:
At the funeral, the same blue window appears before {player}.

« Previous host deceased. Transferring the System... Part of the bloodline's power has been preserved. »
ev.sys_inheritance.title: [SYSTEM] New Host
ev.sys_welcome.desc:
A translucent blue window floats above the crib. Nobody else can see it.

« Skills granted: Gamer's Mind, Gamer's Body, Observe. »

Your life is now a game. Level up.
ev.sys_welcome.title: [SYSTEM] Welcome, Player
ev.system_glitch.desc: The windows flash red. « Host exceeded expected parameters. Recalibrating... »
ev.system_glitch.resist.ok: For an instant you see the code behind the world.
ev.system_glitch.title: [SYSTEM] ERROR 0x00F4
ev.teacher_mentor.accept.res: The lessons change the way you study.
ev.teacher_mentor.desc: {name} stays after class. "You have potential. I want to tutor you."
ev.teacher_mentor.title: Your teacher believes in you
ev.tooth_fairy.desc: Your tooth fell out! Under your pillow in the morning there's a coin... and a System window: « Rare item obtained? No. It's just a coin. »
ev.tooth_fairy.ok.res: Even the System has a sense of humor.
ev.tooth_fairy.title: Baby tooth
ev.travel_romance.desc: On a distant beach, {name} invites you to watch the sunset.
ev.travel_romance.no.res: You watch the sunset alone. It's beautiful too.
ev.travel_romance.title: Holiday romance
ev.travel_romance.yes.res: An unforgettable night. Some things should stay on the trip...
ev.unlicensed_stop.desc: "License and registration, please." You don't have a driver's license.
ev.unlicensed_stop.honest.res: A fine and a record. Maybe it's time for driving school.
ev.unlicensed_stop.title: Checkpoint
ev.vehicle_breakdown.desc: Your vehicle dies at the worst possible moment.
ev.vehicle_breakdown.diy.fail: You made it worse. Tow truck.
ev.vehicle_breakdown.diy.ok: Grease up to the elbows, but it worked.
ev.vehicle_breakdown.title: Breakdown!
ev.viral_post.desc: One of your posts exploded. Thousands of shares.
ev.viral_post.monetize.res: Brands start sliding into your DMs.
ev.viral_post.title: It went viral!
ev.wallet_owner.desc: A police officer knocks with a photo of you taking the wallet.
ev.wallet_owner.pay.res: No charges, but plenty of shame.
ev.wallet_owner.title: Security cameras
ev.work_boss_conflict.confront.ok: {name} backs off. "Maybe I went too far."
ev.work_boss_conflict.desc: {name} criticizes your work in front of everyone. Again.
ev.work_boss_conflict.endure.res: Gamer's Mind holds the anger in. For now.
ev.work_boss_conflict.quit.res: You leave your badge on {name}'s desk and walk out.
ev.work_boss_conflict.title: Boss on your case
ev.work_credit_stolen.desc: {name} presented YOUR project as their own. The boss loved it.
ev.work_credit_stolen.expose.fail: It looks like jealousy. Nobody believes you.
ev.work_credit_stolen.expose.ok: Your emails prove everything. {name} is humiliated.
ev.work_credit_stolen.title: Stolen credit
ev.work_headhunter.accept.res: New badge, new salary, new boss.
ev.work_headhunter.desc: A competitor offers you 25% more to switch companies.
ev.work_headhunter.title: Headhunter
ev.work_office_romance.desc: {name} asks you for coffee after work. It doesn't seem like just coffee.
ev.work_office_romance.go.fail: It really was just coffee. Awkward.
ev.work_office_romance.go.ok: Coffee becomes dinner. Dinner becomes dating.
ev.work_office_romance.no.res: Better not to mix things up.
ev.work_office_romance.title: Office chemistry
ev.work_overtime.accept.res: Extra money in the bank. Extra bags under your eyes.
ev.work_overtime.desc: An urgent project. Well-paid overtime, but there goes your weekend.
ev.work_overtime.title: Overtime
ev.world_reveal.desc: On your way home, the air in front of you cracks like glass. Something with claws steps out. Nobody on the street reacts — time seems frozen. A voice shouts: "You can move?! Then you're one of us!"
ev.world_reveal.fight.fail: The creature throws you into a wall. {name} destroys it with a gesture and explains everything: rifts, the Awakened, guilds. And how to create your own Dungeon.
ev.world_reveal.fight.ok: Your punch goes through the creature. {name}, a veteran Awakened, whistles: "Level {level} and you fight like that?" You learn to create Instant Dungeons.
ev.world_reveal.run.res: You run. {name} catches up later: "Running is a skill too. But you'll need others."
ev.world_reveal.title: The sky tears open
